fix: installer scripts — ASCII encoding, direct file copy, zip release

IExpress exe had multiple issues:
- Temp folder deleted before PowerShell could read payload zip
- Unicode box-drawing chars broke cmd.exe encoding
- Nested quotes in bat caused parsing failures

Solution: zip-based release instead of IExpress exe
- Build-ZipRelease.ps1: creates Student-Setup.zip + Teacher-Setup.zip
- Install scripts copy files directly (no nested zip extraction)
- All output ASCII-only (no Unicode box chars)
- Tested: Student zip -> INSTALL.bat -> agent connected to server

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat: Teacher-Setup.exe + Student-Setup.exe with portable Node.js

- Teacher exe (76MB): server + dashboard + bundled node.exe runtime
- Student exe (33MB): full Socket.IO agent + portable node.exe
- No Node.js installation required on either side
- Student: prompts for teacher server URL, registers auto-start task
- Teacher: installs to C:\Enterprise-PC-Management, opens dashboard
- Build-Installers.ps1: use .NET ZipFile (fixes OOM with Compress-Archive)
- Added all missing installer scripts (payload extractors + launchers)

feat: deploy full Node.js agent bundle instead of PowerShell poller

Replace PS Monitor.ps1 (REST polling only) with complete Node.js agent
bundle deployment via WinRM PSSession:

- bundle-agent.js: packages node.exe + agent.js + node_modules into zip (33MB)
- deploy /auto: copies zip via PSSession, extracts, registers scheduled task
- oneclick/full-setup: same bundle deployment for batch operations
- GET /deploy/bundle-status: check if bundle exists
- POST /deploy/rebuild-bundle: regenerate bundle on demand
- .gitignore: exclude deploy-bundle/ directory

Student PCs now get the full agent with Socket.IO real-time connection,
screen streaming, remote commands, and program blocking — no Node.js
installation required on the student PC.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix: security hardening — PS injection, credential exposure, JWT consistency

- sanitizeForPS: block quotes, angle brackets, hash (PS injection vectors)
- GET /credentials/default: admin-only, no plaintext password in response
- WebSocket JWT: use getSecret() instead of hardcoded 'dev-secret'
- auth.middleware: export getSecret, throw on missing secret (no silent fallback)
- POST /pcs/:name/status: add optionalAuth middleware
- .gitignore: protect DB files, screenshots, logs from git
- setup-env.js: auto-generate .env with secure random secrets
- agent run cmd: add maxBuffer + result logging
